notes.title: Flockers: Release Update
notes.content:
[img=http://www.goodgame.hr/wp-content/uploads/2014/03/flockers-header02-600x300.jpg]

Shepherds!

We're but 2 days away from the launch of Flockers as a full game here on Steam. It's been a hell of a journey through Early Access - together we've slain bugs, tweaked features and saved countless scores of sheep from their horrible, weaponised fate created by the [url=http://twitter.com/wormsteam17]Worms[/url]. 

...we've also accidentally led countless scores [i]more[/i] to their doom, but let's gloss over that minor hiccup.

We can't thank everyone who took part in our Early Access enough. Ewe've* been excellent. The feedback you have given us has helped us to make a really great game that is [url=http://www.metacritic.com/game/pc/flockers]already getting brilliant reviews, both by players and the games press.[/url]

As small thanks, we've uploaded the release version of Flockers to Steam today. Anyone with Early Access can play the full Flockers experience 2 days before general release. 

Here's the skinny on the release update:

[b]New Stuff[/b]
[list]
[*]5 New Campaign Levels, bringing the total level count to 60! (NOT including Bonus / Meat Maker levels)
[*]1 New Bonus Level to unlock!
[*]More Rewards available to unlock!
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes & Tweaks[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a crash that occassionally occurred when launching the game
[*]Fixed a crash in the options menu
[*]Fixed an OpenGL error that caused some users to be unable to launch the game
[*]Fixed an issue effecting blood graphics on some Intel graphics cards
[*]Made optimisations to min spec graphics cards – Flockers can now support Nvidia GeForce 8600 GS/AMD Radeon HD 4650 and equivalent.
[*]Tweaked the loading screens to make transitioning between levels smoother
[/list]

Over the next 2 days, we'll also be removing all the developer scores from the in-game leaderboards. Your scores will remain, and this is your chance to set the bar for the influx of new players heading to Flockers over the coming months. Do us proud, make them work for the top spot.

It's not all in-game though. We need your [url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=260330]Meat Maker[/url] levels, your [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/260330/guides/]Guides[/url], your [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/260330/reviews/]Reviews[/url] and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/260330/discussions/]Discussions[/url] to help make the Flockers community an amazing place to be. I'll be highlighting the very best of your creations; in the forums, on [url=http://twitter.com/flockersgame]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/FlockersGame]Facebook[/url] and here within Team17 too - we all can't wait to see what you can make!

From everyone here at Team17, thank ewe** for saving our sheep.

MT17

*That's the last time I'll do that during early access, I promise.

**I lied.

notes.title: Flockers Update 4 Now Available! Build #381
notes.content:
Flockers!

Update 4 is here, bringing with it 5 new levels, new rewards, more Steam achievements to earn and some lovely tweaks to the campaign level select screen.

Oh, there's also something SUPER SECRET for you and your Flock to find.

Read on for the full changelog!

[b]New Stuff![/b]
[list]
[*]5 new levels. This includes 5 new campaign missions and... something else...
[*]5 new rewards to be unlocked in-game!
[*]5 new Steam achievements to be unlocked in-game!
[*]More epic changes to the campaign level selection screen!
[*]A whole host of bug fixes – see below.
[/list]

[b]Changes, fixes and tweaks:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a crash occurring for some users when an Exploder detonates on level 10
[*]Fixed a crash which occurred when exiting the results screen
[*]Fixed the "Doing Great" achievement - it can now be unlocked as normal
[*]Fixed some Sheep physics - sheep now won't be blown as far away from an explosion if another sheep is on top of them
[*]Fixed an issue with Steam Workshop integration which caused the main window to remain open after launching the level editor
[*]Depth of Field has been enabled by default
[*]Fixed a bug which caused the game to hang on the loading screen after completing a level
[*]Fixed issues causing FPS drops whilst streaming on Twitch
[*]Fixed game crashes when selecting certain levels 
[*]Fixed a crash which occurred when changing settings in the Controls menu
[*]Fixed the Cyber Sheep so that it can now be unlocked as intended
[*]Fixed an issue with sheep getting stuck on level 33
[*]Fixed an issue with a secret level which prevented it from being unlocked
[*]Fixed various issues which occurred in the Rewards menu
[*]Fixed various issues with Achievements that prevented them from being unlocked. There's still some outstanding issues with Achievements, check the Known Issues for details.
[*]Fixed a crash that occurrs when the Team17 intro video is skipped
[*]Fixed an issue which caused full stars to be displayed regardless of how many were actually earned
[*]Fixed an issue affecting Super Sheep which caused them to fly too high
[*]Fixed an issue which caused formation boxes to stay on screen after the level is reset
[*]Fixed a crash which occurred when exiting the game
[*]Fixed an issue causing Sheep to get stuck in formation on rotating platforms
[*]Fixed an issue preventing sheep in a two stair formation from jumping normally
[*]Fixed a graphical issue which occurred after minimising the game window on level 29
[*]Localised the "Cleared" and "Failed" text
[*]Fixed an issue which caused the bottom sheep in a formation to slide down slopes
[*]Fixed an issue causing the Exploder Sheep's timer remaining after the game is paused and then restarted
[*]Fixed an issue causing camera weirdness
[*]Added text explaining how to unlock Lambo and the Cyber Sheep
[*]Fixed an issue causing Jumper sheep to jump down slopes instead of walking
[*]Fixed an issue causing the game to crash after changing filters at the Leaderboard
[*]Fixed an issue which caused a crash when Alt-tabbing out of full screen while streaming
[*]Fixed lighting for some levels
[*]Fixed an issue causing localized level names to spill outside the display area
[*]Fixed an issue causing Jumper sheep to miss the exit in level 26.
[*]Fixed an issue with the Level 29 landscape, which was much higher than its collision area
[*]Increased the size of unlocked levels in the Level Select menu
[*]Fixed an issue that allowed Giblets to press Constant Switches
[*]Fixed an issue with the level select button, which was obstructed by the button above it
[*]Fixed a few backend issues with Twitch streaming
[*]Localised level 26-30 titles
[*]Fixed an issue causing ammo to be returned to the player after releasing sheep from a formation before it's full
[*]Added a button for viewing Twitch streams 
[*]Fixed a graphics bug with the floating beam in level 14
[*]Fixed an issue causing the camera to move the cursor when trying to select level
[*]Fixed an issue which prevented navigating up using the keyboard controls on the How to Play screen 
[*]Fixed an issue causing the star animation on the results screen to stop if the mouse is clicked
[*]Fixed Sheep clipping through background assets on level 29
[*]Fixed an issue causing a blank panel to be displayed upon opening the level select screen
[*]Fixed an issue causing Jumper sheep to get stuck against low diagonal ceilings 
[*]Fixed various graphical issues in level 27
[*]Fixed audio issues which occurred when applying abilities to sleeping sheep
[*]Fixed an issue causing the Russian text for Leaderboards to be slightly cut off by the filter button 
[*]Changed Mission 30 in the level select screen, it's now Mission 31.
[*]Fixed an issue which occurred when using Delete Formation while using the Formation cursor, causing both cursor types to be displayed at the same time
[*]Added keyboard/controller control for the New Reward screen
[*]Fixed an issue causing 2 cursors to be seen when changing to delete formation in pause mode
[*]Gave the Angel Sheep (Unluckius Lambus) a new cape
[*]Fixed a graphical issue with Sleeping Sheep "Z"'s
[*]Added a prompt to alert the user that video/audio settings cannot be changed during a stream 
[*]Fixed German localisation text clipping on the How to Play screen
[*]Fixed graphical issues with the Teleporter particle effects
[*]Fixed incorrect visuals and collision when using a flipped 'door' object
[*]Corrected the non-English text on the rewards screen, which was showing the Zombie Sheep text for most sheep
[*]Corrected various level numbers
[*]Fixed an issue causing rope joints to not draw chains when there are lots of objects in a scene
[*]Fixed an issue causing Giblets from previous attempts remain to after restarting the level
[*]Fixed and tweaked various minor graphics issues
[*]Fixed an issue in the Level Editor when pausing which caused the cursor to lock to top-right of game window
[*]Added a level select button for level 35, which was missing previously
[/list]

[b]Hotfixes[/b]

Hotfixes are small changes to the game which compliment the latest update. Since this update was published, the following hotfixes have been made:

[list]
[*]Fixed the "Soft Landing" achievement so that it can now be unlocked.
[*]Localised level names have been added for secret levels.
[*]Localised level names have been added for levels 31-35.
[*]Fixed the Red Head Band/Lambo reward, which is now awarded after finishing the correct level. 
[*]Fixed the Red Head band, Punk and Leaf themed Sheep which now appear correctly in the Rewards menu.
[*]Tweaked the amount of decoration silhouettes in the background
[/list]

We're always keen to get your feedback on the latest updates, so go and have a play! Let us know what you like, what you don't like and what you'd like to see more of in [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/260330/discussions/2/540744934436925777/]the forums[/url]. Be sure to check out the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/260330/discussions/0/558754900064682934/]Known Issues thread[/url] for a list of problems that we're working to resolve. 

As ever, keep those eyes peeled for pesky bugs - you can report them to us in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/260330/discussions/0/558754260589337694/] Bugs & Support forum.[/url]

Have fun!

Mike_Team17

notes.content:

We've been hard at work on getting a load of new features added to the game and have recently released an update

- Level Editor -  Editor window now updates automatically when objects are rotated, rather than restarting by selecting edit mode.
- Level Editor – Editor window now updates automatically when objects are scaled, rather than restarting by selecting edit mode.
- Level Editor – Improvements to mouse and camera controls.
- Level Editor – Added a cursor highlight so it is obvious which object is being selected.

The bugs list has also been updated following this new release. 

Best regards, 
Team17.

notes.content:
[h1]Patch notes for build #298[/h1]

Hey all,


We've just released Update 2, build number #298, for Flockers!

The game should now run correctly on Windows XP machines.
The editor is in a far more usable state and has a detailed set of help text to accompany it.

For a comprehensive list of all changes introduced in this game version, please find the patch notes below:

Content and changes:
-	[b]Main Game[/b]– 5 new levels in the Factory Interior theme (26-30)
-	[b]Main Game[/b] – Issues with XP operating system compatibility have been fixed.
-	[b]Level Editor[/b] - Big changes to the Level Editor help text.
-	[b]Level Editor[/b] - Motor states and switches are working correctly.
-	[b]Level Editor[/b] - More objects now appear without a refresh required.
-	[b]Level Editor[/b] – Some joints now have graphics in the edit window and have thumbnail images on the editor window – Rope, Revolute, Prismatic and Pulley all now have images. 



[h1]Main Game:[/h1]

[b]IMMEDIATE FIXES:[/b]
[list]
[*]0042375: Star scoring system is not matching up to the results screen 
[*]0042326: Star ratings are not correctly displayed when player improves upon score 
[*]0042473: Game fails to launch on XP machine 
[*]0042147: Levels 21-25 need to use Factory Exterior theme 
[*]0040697: If cursor is over sleeping sheep, can't assign ability after they wake up 
[*]0042294: Game crashes when pressing "Next" between some levels 
[*]0042308: Constant switch light remains active when no sheep are on it 
[*]0041905: Game flickers black several times when player uses 'Next' to advance to next level 
[*]0042391: Exploded pObjects are not being cleared up 
[*]0042340: Unable to get anti-grav sheep into exit on Level 23 
[*]0042508: Revolute joints not acting consistently in level 1038 
[*]0042524: Game becomes soft locked after any custom level is completed
[*]0042388: Pressing next on a Workshop level causes soft lock 
[/list]

[b]URGENT FIXES:[/b]
[list]
[*]0042136: Super Sheep flying through a gap they shouldnt
[*]0042160: After a restart, customisations from abilities look really small
[*]0041648: Exploder range on level 1029 seems too low 
[*]0042436: Results screen appears after 1 Sheep enters the exit in Lambo - First Blood (minor)
[*]0041897: Wooden Crates do not look destructible 
[/list]


[b]HIGH PRIORITY FIXES:[/b]
[list]
[*]0042417: Partial stars are being combined across levels to award full stars 
[*]0042048: Screen turns black when disconnecting on Leaderboards 
[*]0042475: No error message is given if connection is lost 
[*]0042237: Marquee graphic present on pause menu 
[*]0042189: No sound when the formation lands/a sheep enters a formation on the landscape 
[/list]


[b]NORMAL PRIORITY FIXES:[/b]

[*]0042477: It is possible to get a score of 0 in the Monthly leaderboards by failing the level 
[*]0040725: Mines have no detonation state 
[*]0042272: Top sheep in 2-block stair formation remains floating if bottom sheep is killed
[*]0042270: Light emitter on Exit gate is offset when camera is moved 
[*]0041845: Underscores don't appear in-game 
[*]0042253: level 15 has a light that intersects with a lift 
[*]0042247: Audio sliders appear to have no keyboard control functionality
[*]0042429: Teleport effect isn't seen when Sheep pass through 
[*]0041495: Exploder Timers are not removed after Exploder sheep die 
[*]0042392: Leaderboard message states "You've moved up 1 places on the Global leaderboard!" 
[*]0042243: Greyed out arrows are missing from the FE 
[*]0042248: Sleeping sheep Sleep animation stuck on frame 0 
[*]0041563: Exploder explosions are not heard in fast forward 
[*]0042369: Formation outline is visible within in-game menus 
[/list]


[b]LOW PRIORITY FIXES:[/b]
[list]
[*]0041438: Fast forward sound playing while paused. 
[*]0041851: Leaderboards don't load in Steam profiles 
[*]0041370: Explosion audio will continue to play when game is paused

[h1]Level Editor:[/h1]

[/list]

notes.title: Version #283 of Flockers out now
notes.content:
For notes on the changes and fixes included in this update, please see below:

Level 3
- New marquee helper decorative formations.
- Removed spikes from next to wooden box.
- Increased height of wooden box.
- Added a block to the end of the moving platform near the exit point.
(score requirements have not changed)
 
Level 6
- Removed 2 guillotines from the end of the level.
- Slowed remaining guillotine down.
- Moved exit point on ‘Robosheep’ further forward to avoid any potential sheep deaths on buzzsaw.
- Extra 2-step formation and 2 releases so that the sleeping sheep near the rolling pObject can be saved.
(score requirements have not changed)
 
Level 8
- Edits made to the left side of the landscape. A hazard has been removed and teleports have been added as a means of getting onto the robot.
- A hazard was removed from the lower right section to make it easier for players to work out what the constant switch's function is.
- Only 1 constant switch is now used instead of the previous 2.
- Changes made to the speed of the platform and the underside of the landscape to the right of the platform. This makes it possible to save the sheep sat on the switch.
- 10 more sheep have been added to the right side.
- Score requirements have been updated to 10000 / 230000 / 460000
 
Level 21
- Timer has been reduced from 71,000 minutes to 10 minutes. 0042346: MF1: Functional: Level timer on Level 21 begins at 71582:47
 
Early Access DLC
- Early access bonus content is now available and can be found in the Flockers root install folder (C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Flockers).
- Content can be found in the folders; Flockers Art, Flockers Soundtrack and Flockers Wallpapers.
 
Enjoy!
 
Thank you,
Team17
